camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi DeleteSecretBlacklist --region cn-hangzhou --BlackType POINT_TO_POINT_BLACK --PoolKey FC12320000 --BlackNo '18250000383:18250000483' --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Deletes the blacklist of a number pool. Only number pools of the AXN privacy number, AXN extension number, and 95AXN privacy number types support blacklists
description_zh: 删除号码池的黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi delete-secret-blacklist --pool-key FC12320000 --black-no 18250000383:18250000483 --black-type POINT_TO_POINT_BLACK --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSecretBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The blacklisted number. The value type is determined by the BlackType parameter:

Point-to-point blacklist: a pair of numbers separated by a colon (:)
Number pool blacklist: a single number
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单号码。根据BlackType参数值决定取值类型：

点对点黑名单：一对号码，用英文冒号（:）分隔。
号池黑名单：单个号码
parameters.name: black_no

parameters.help_en:
The type of the blacklist. Valid values:

POINT_TO_POINT_BLACK: point-to-point blacklist
PARTNER_GLOBAL_NUMBER_BLACK: number pool blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单类型。取值：

POINT_TO_POINT_BLACK：点对点黑名单。
PARTNER_GLOBAL_NUMBER_BLACK：号池黑名单
parameters.name: black_type

parameters.help_en:
The call direction control. Valid values:

PHONEA_REJECT: The first number in BlackNo can call the second number, but the second number cannot call the first number.

PHONEB_REJECT: The first number in BlackNo cannot call the second number, but the second number can call the first number.

Leave empty: The two numbers in BlackNo cannot call each other
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫方向控制。取值：

PHONEA_REJECT：BlackNo中第一个号码可以呼叫第二个号码，第二个号码不能呼叫第一个。

PHONEB_REJECT：BlackNo中第一个号码不可呼叫第二个号码，第二个号码可呼叫第一个号码。

不填：BlackNo中两个号码不可相互呼叫
parameters.name: way_control

Code.description_zh:
